limitations: This ledger verifies mathematical transcription and formula preservation for PDF18–57 in English/Chinese. It is not an assertion that all 923 pages of the book are translated or independently reviewed. SHA-256 snapshots identify the source files after the reviewed visible source correction notes were added.
